subject: Hands-on runbook + load window coordination
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@logistix.ai>, Samir Patel <spatel@logistix.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hands-on runbook + load window coordination

Hi Avery / Samir —

Following our discovery, we want to lock in a 2-hour hands-on session to run through the POC playbook: prompt review, routing configuration, and a lightweight load test to validate steady-state latency. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue 19 Mar, 10:00–12:00
- Wed 20 Mar, 14:00–16:00

Agenda (high-level):
1) Short intro (10m)
2) Prompt set walkthrough & tuning (30m)
3) Routing policy validation + KV/prefix caching demo (25m)
4) Load test (45m) — steady-state 50 qps burst to 200 for short spikes
5) Action items & next steps (10m)

I've attached an initial runbook and a test matrix. If those slots don't work share alternatives and any org constraints (maintenance windows / IP allowlists).

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

Thanks Rishi — Wed 20 Mar 14:00–16:00 PST works best for our engineering team. Two quick notes:

- We have an internal maintenance slot Tue morning so Tue 19 is tough.
- Can we cap initial sustained load to 40 qps and only spike to 150 for short bursts? We want to avoid tripping our API gateway throttles while we observe.

Samir (cc'ed) will add any IP allowlist details.

Cheers,
Avery

Date: Thu, 20 Mar 2024 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Hands-on runbook + load window coordination — session recap & actions

Hi all — thanks for a productive session today. Recap + owners below (short):

What we did:
- Walked through prompt set and tuned two templates to reduce hallucination on short answers.
- Validated routing policy: primary -> low-cost quant model, fallback to standard quantized model on error.
- Ran the load script: sustained 40 qps, 30s spike to 150 qps at T+25m. Metrics looked good: 95th latency stayed ~420ms, error rate stayed <0.7%.

Action items (owner — due):
- Logistix to provide final IP/CIDR for allowlist (Samir — 2024-03-22)
- Redwood to export session artifacts and trimmed runbook to Drive (Monica — 2024-03-21)
- Karthik to share alert dashboard and raw load logs (Karthik — 2024-03-21)
- Rishi to propose next session scope (routing at scale + extended soak test) and draft a mutual action plan (Rishi — 2024-03-22)

Next session: propose week of 25 Mar — I’ll send a short poll by EOD Fri 22 Mar.

Attachments: session_screenshots.zip (attachment stub), redwood_runbook_v1.pdf (updated excerpt)
